identify.description: Segment identify call mapped to Braze /users/track with attributes array

track.description: Segment track call mapped to Braze /users/track with events array

track_purchase.description: Segment track call with revenue mapped to Braze /users/track with purchases array

page.description: Segment page call mapped to Braze /users/track as a custom event

group.description: Segment group call mapped to Braze /users/track as user attributes with group prefix

alias.description: Segment alias call mapped to Braze /users/identify endpoint to merge user profiles

identify.description: RudderStack identify call mapped to Braze /users/track with attributes array

track.description: RudderStack track call mapped to Braze /users/track with events array

track_purchase.description: RudderStack track call with revenue mapped to Braze /users/track with purchases array

page.description: RudderStack page call mapped to Braze /users/track as a custom event

group.description: RudderStack group call mapped to Braze /users/track as user attributes with group prefix

alias.description: RudderStack alias call mapped to Braze /users/identify endpoint to merge user profiles

external_id_derivation.segment: external_id derived from userId in the Segment event; falls back to anonymousId via user_alias if userId is absent
external_id_derivation.rudderstack: external_id derived from userId in the RudderStack event; falls back to anonymousId via user_alias if userId is absent

attribute_vs_event_vs_purchase_routing.identify_to_attributes: Both platforms map identify calls to the attributes array in /users/track. Segment traits and RudderStack traits are mapped to Braze user attributes.
attribute_vs_event_vs_purchase_routing.track_to_events: Both platforms map track calls to the events array in /users/track. Event name maps to Braze event name, event properties map to Braze event properties.
attribute_vs_event_vs_purchase_routing.track_to_purchases: When a track call contains revenue or products array (Order Completed), both platforms route to the purchases array in /users/track instead of events.
attribute_vs_event_vs_purchase_routing.page_to_events: Both platforms map page calls to custom events in the events array. Segment uses 'Loaded a Page' as event name; RudderStack uses the same convention.
attribute_vs_event_vs_purchase_routing.group_to_attributes: Both platforms map group calls to user attributes prefixed with group information. Group traits become custom attributes on the user profile.
attribute_vs_event_vs_purchase_routing.alias_to_identify: Both platforms map alias calls to the /users/identify endpoint to merge anonymous and identified user profiles.

property_name_mapping.first_name: traits.firstName or traits.first_name → first_name (Braze reserved attribute)
property_name_mapping.last_name: traits.lastName or traits.last_name → last_name (Braze reserved attribute)
property_name_mapping.phone: traits.phone → phone (Braze reserved attribute, E.164 format)
property_name_mapping.home_city: traits.city or traits.address.city → home_city (Braze reserved attribute)
property_name_mapping.country: traits.country or traits.address.country → country (Braze reserved attribute)
property_name_mapping.date_of_birth: traits.birthday → dob (Braze reserved attribute, YYYY-MM-DD format)
property_name_mapping.gender: traits.gender → gender (Braze reserved attribute: M, F, O, N, P)
property_name_mapping.custom_attributes: All other traits are passed as custom attributes with original key names
property_name_mapping.revenue: properties.revenue → price (required for purchases, numeric value)
property_name_mapping.currency: properties.currency → currency (ISO 4217 code, defaults to USD)
property_name_mapping.quantity: properties.quantity → quantity (defaults to 1 if not provided)

time_format.segment: ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2026-02-25T12:00:00.000Z) — timestamps sent as-is to Braze
time_format.rudderstack: ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2026-02-25T12:00:00.000Z) — timestamps sent as-is to Braze
time_format.braze_requirement: Braze accepts ISO 8601 timestamps with timezone offset or UTC (Z suffix). Maximum precision: seconds.

app_id_config.description: Braze app_id is required for events and purchases. Configured in destination settings, not derived from event payload.
app_id_config.segment: app_id from Braze destination settings in Segment workspace
app_id_config.rudderstack: app_id from Braze destination config in RudderStack dashboard

rest_api_endpoint_config.description: Braze REST API endpoint varies by data center cluster. Must be configured per destination.

known_parity_gaps.subscription_group_handling: Segment supports updating Braze subscription groups via identify traits (braze_subscription_groups). RudderStack support may differ.
known_parity_gaps.nested_custom_attributes: Braze supports nested custom attributes (objects and arrays). Both platforms should pass nested traits as nested custom attributes.
known_parity_gaps.user_alias_flow: Both platforms support user_alias for anonymous user tracking before identification. Implementation of alias resolution may have subtle timing differences.
known_parity_gaps.purchase_event_deduplication: Order Completed events with products array: Segment creates one purchase per product item. RudderStack should follow the same pattern.
known_parity_gaps.batching_strategy: Braze /users/track supports up to 75 total objects per request. Segment and RudderStack may batch differently before sending to Braze API.
known_parity_gaps.rate_limiting: Braze rate limit: 3,000 requests per 3 seconds base limit. Both platforms should implement appropriate backoff strategies.

notes: Braze shared cloud destination. Categories: Email Marketing, Marketing Automation, SMS & Push. Segment has 4 variants: Classic, Cloud Actions (actions-braze-cloud), Cohorts (actions-braze-cohorts), Web Device Mode (braze-web-device-mode-actions). RudderStack delivers via Router REST API pipeline through the external Transformer service on port 9090. Primary Braze API endpoint is /users/track which accepts attributes, events, and purchases arrays in a single request. Both platforms derive external_id from userId and support user_alias for anonymous users. Braze is a P1 critical enterprise destination in the destination priority ranking.
